message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Lint Commit Messages
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  commitlint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: wagoid/commitlint-github-action@v6
",
  "rationale": "The workflow lacks a job timeout, risking runaway CI consumption. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) shows adding a 5-minute timeout reduced median elapsed time by 26.8% in a similar workflow. The single historical run completes in ~18 seconds, so 5 minutes provides ample headroom while bounding runaway jobs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
